name: Sports clubs
seoTitle: Shopify developer for sports clubs and fan shops
intro: Fan shops and club websites on Shopify for Swiss football and ice hockey clubs, and the shirt configurator for a Saudi football club: personalised jerseys, bundles that check out as one line, auctions, match content and customer-specific pricing.

name: Fashion & apparel
seoTitle: Shopify developer for fashion, footwear and apparel brands
intro: Shopify work for fashion, footwear and apparel brands: six stores in three currencies for Nile, a Meilisearch search layer and a B2B showroom for Inuikii, gift cards for a jeans retailer, and theme work for Swiss and US clothing brands.

name: Food & drink
seoTitle: Shopify developer for food, confectionery and drinks brands
intro: Stores for Swiss confectioners and a German drinks brand: Sprüngli's design rebuilt on Dawn, allergen filters in three languages for Bruderer, and can deposit (Pfand) handling for Glory Bomb.

name: Health & beauty
seoTitle: Shopify developer for health, beauty and medical stores
intro: Oral care, cosmetics, natural remedies and medical supplies: the Curaprox redesign for Switzerland and the UAE, Lush Switzerland, Chrüterhüsli on Horizon, and Mediconsult's stores for ophthalmologists and opticians.

name: Home & building
seoTitle: Shopify developer for home, heating and building products
intro: Heating, dehumidifiers, swim spas, pergolas, fireplaces, lighting, signage and window film: stores where products are large, configurable or installed, with credit checks, installation pricing and discount logic to match.

name: Print & personalised products
seoTitle: Shopify developer for print and personalised products
intro: Custom Shopify theme work for US stores that print and personalise: stationery and gifts, branded merchandise, custom t-shirts, photo wall art, and forms for dental and medical practices.

name: Specialist retail & services
seoTitle: Shopify developer for specialist retailers and service businesses
intro: Refurbished electronics, fireworks and a car wash chain: a filter extension app for Revendo, stores for the fireworks retailers Pyrostar, Bugano and Weco, and customer account features for OSCARwash.

name: Apps & tools
seoTitle: Shopify app developer: admin apps and internal tools
intro: Shopify admin apps built for client projects: a PrestaShop to Shopify migration app that never emails a customer, and a content sync app that keeps metaobjects, menus and translations aligned across stores.
